summary: Ascendis Pharma filed a Form 6-K reporting new radiographic data from Week 104 of the pivotal ApproaCH Trial of TransCon CNP in children with achondroplasia. The filing describes clinical trial results, including improvements in lower extremity alignment and growth velocity, with no financial terms, stake percentages, prices, or dates related to a special situation. This is a routine disclosure of clinical data, not a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change.
